topic.readerProblem: People searching Nightwatch tracking, pricing and prompt tracking need the current price of its AI visibility tracking, what the plans include, and whether it is worth paying for.
topic.connection: AEOeye measures whether AI engines name a brand; the page explains what a daily tracker's quota can and cannot tell you and points readers to a free audit before they pay to track.

assessment: The page replaces outdated add-on pricing ($32 base, $99 AI add-on, $131+) with Nightwatch's current plan table, where AI prompts are included in every plan, and flags which amounts are derived rather than printed. It adds two clearly hypothetical worked examples, our arithmetic on answers per prompt, the SparkToro/Gumshoe consistency study as the reason to read visibility percentage rather than position, and a cheapest-first ladder. It does not claim hands-on use, rankings or outcomes for Nightwatch.

sources.supports: Plan table: keywords, AI prompts, AI answers per month, yearly rates and Save badges, same tools and six AI platforms on every plan, 14-day trial without card, auto-billing FAQ, Professional extras, Black Friday banner, euro display.
AI Visibility, Average Position, Share of Voice and Sentiment metrics; Citation Intelligence; daily updates.
Homepage positioning: rank tracking and AI visibility in one platform.

600 volunteers, 12 prompts, 2,961 runs on ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI; <1 in 100 chance of the same brand list, ~1 in 1,000 for same order; visibility percentage across dozens to hundreds of runs as a reasonable metric.
Dated 30 January 2026; summary of the SparkToro study and its metric recommendation.
Lite $29/month for 15 prompts; Standard $189/month for 100 prompts.
Starter $95/month for 50 prompts; Pro $245/month for 150 prompts (rendered in a real browser).
Free trial: 50 prompts run daily for 7 days.
